info.title: goliath
info.description: Firefox-based browser automation for AI agents with configurable anti-detection measures. Accessibility snapshots, stable element refs, human-like actions, secure uploads, session isolation, and structured logs.

tags.name: Tabs
tags.description: Create, list, inspect, and destroy browser tabs.

tags.name: Navigation
tags.description: Navigate tabs to URLs or via search macros.

tags.name: Interaction
tags.description: Click, type, scroll, press keys, evaluate JS.

tags.name: Content
tags.description: Accessibility snapshots, screenshots, links, images, downloads.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token matching GOLIATH_API_KEY (per-route auth for sensitive endpoints like cookie import and traces).

AccessKeyAuth.description: Bearer token matching GOLIATH_ACCESS_KEY. Required for non-loopback access and accepted as a superkey by routes that normally require GOLIATH_API_KEY.

ApprovalRequired.description: Returned instead of acting when a click/type/hands request targets a dangerous control and confirm was not true. Set GOLIATH_DANGEROUS_ACTIONS=annotate or off to change the behavior.

action.description: What was about to happen, e.g. "Click" or "Type and submit".

element.description: Accessible name of the target control.

domain.description: Hostname of the page the action targets.

SessionPolicy.description: Optional runtime-only capability policy. Unset fields default to allow, and no registered policy preserves unrestricted behavior.

allowedOrigins.description: Exact HTTP(S) origins or scheme-pinned subdomain wildcards such as https://*.example.com.

deniedOrigins.description: Origins denied before allowedOrigins is evaluated.

actions.description: Per-capability decisions. Unset capabilities default to allow.

dangerousActions.description: Hard denies by dangerous-action category. A deny cannot be overridden with confirm: true.

post.summary: Import cookies into a user session
post.description: Import cookies for authenticated browsing. Requires BearerAuth in production.

get.description: Detailed health with tab/session counts and failure tracking.
Returns Prometheus text exposition format. Requires PROMETHEUS_ENABLED=1.

post.description:
Closes tabs observed idle across multiple checks while preserving tabs
with active/queued operations. Never returns URLs, titles, cookies,
page text, or user IDs. Defaults to dry-run mode.

dryRun.description: When true, returns candidates without closing them.

minIdleMs.description: Minimum idle time (ms) before a tab is eligible.

maxTabsToClose.description: Maximum tabs to close per invocation.

minTabsPerSession.description: Preserve at least this many tabs per session.

closeEmptySessions.description: Close sessions left with zero tabs after cleanup.

200.description: Cleanup result with before/after counts and hashed metadata.

post.description: Creates a tab in the given session. Optionally navigates to an initial URL.

trace.description: Enable Playwright tracing for this session (screenshots, DOM snapshots, network). Must be set on first tab creation; cannot be added to an existing session.

409.description: Cannot enable tracing on an existing session.

get.description: Returns all tabs for a given userId.

post.summary: Navigate a tab to a URL or macro
post.description: Navigate to a URL or expand a search macro. Auto-creates tab if not found.

get.description: Returns accessibility tree with element refs. Supports pagination via offset.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Reduce the snapshot to agent-actionable content before windowing: lines with element refs, iframe boundaries, headings, and their tree ancestors. Refs remain valid; text-only content is dropped. Pagination offsets refer to the filtered text.

filter.description: Present when a filter was applied.

fullChars.description: Unfiltered snapshot length, for measuring savings.

200.description: Semantic snapshot with stable identities, diffs, readiness, and provenance.

post.summary: Pause for or resume after human handoff
Plan and policy-check a semantic action

409.description: Requested snapshot is no longer current.

post.summary: Execute and verify an action contract

postconditions.description: Every condition is required to pass. URL patterns use bounded literal matching with optional ^ and $ anchors; regular expressions are not evaluated.

get.summary: Compile successful contract actions into a reusable workflow

200.description: Semantic workflow steps without secret values.

post.summary: Wait for a selector or timeout

post.description: Click by element ref, CSS selector, or coordinates.

holdMs.description: Sustained pointer-down duration in milliseconds. Explicitly enables press-and-hold instead of a tap.

humanized.description: Use curved pointer motion, hesitation, micro-movements, and variable click timing.

visualize.description: Show a temporary pointer and click pulse in the page for live viewers.

confirm.description: Required to click a control classified as dangerous (send, pay, publish, delete, sign, confirm, transfer, change password). Without it the route returns an ApprovalRequired body instead of clicking.

200.description: Click result with optional post-action snapshot, or an ApprovalRequired body (`status: approval_required`) when the target is a dangerous control and `confirm` was not true. For humanized clicks, `input.hit` reports the element found under the pointer before the press and `input.delivered` whether a click event reached the target (`null` when that cannot be known: the page navigated, removed or hid the element, or stayed busy past the 2 s probe bound).

409.description: Humanized click could not be verified. `code: target_obscured`: another element sits under the pointer after one corrective re-aim, and nothing was pressed. `code: click_not_delivered`: no pointer or click event reached the target (`retrySafe: true`). `code: click_unconfirmed`: the press reached the target but no click followed, so the page may already have acted (`retrySafe: false`; check the page before retrying). The body carries `hit`, `delivered`, `pointer`, `retrySafe`, and a `hint`.

post.summary: Attach files to an upload control
post.description: Files must resolve inside GOLIATH_UPLOADS_DIR. Supports an existing input[type=file] or a ref/selector that opens a file chooser.
Types text into a focused element or a specific ref/selector.

delay.description: Fixed per-character delay for keyboard mode when humanized is disabled.

humanized.description: Type with variable per-character and punctuation-aware pauses.

confirm.description: Required when submit/pressEnter would submit a form whose submit control or action URL is classified as dangerous; otherwise the route returns an ApprovalRequired body before typing anything.

200.description: Type result, or an ApprovalRequired body (`status: approval_required`) when the submit is dangerous and `confirm` was not true.

confirm.description: Required to press Enter when the focused form's submit control or action is classified as dangerous.

200.description: Key pressed, or an ApprovalRequired body (`status: approval_required`) when Enter would submit something dangerous and `confirm` was not true.

humanized.description: Split the scroll into variable, eased wheel pulses.

visualize.description: Show a temporary pointer and click pulse in the page for live viewers.

post.summary: Execute an ordered list of UI actions (a "hand") in one request
post.description: Multi-step form automation primitive ("voodoo hands"): run an ordered list of click, type, select, check, wait, scroll, press, and submit steps against a single tab in one native request. Stops at the first failing step and reports its index. Preferred over repeated single-action calls for filling multi-field forms.

steps.description: Ordered list of action steps to execute.

selector.description: CSS selector. Required for action "select" (native <select> is not exposed as an a11y ref); optional fallback otherwise.

ms.description: Wait duration. Values over 5000 are clamped to 5000.

confirm.description: User approved this specific dangerous step (after it was refused on this tab).

humanized.description: Use humanized pointer/key timing across the hand.

200.description: Hand result with per-step outcomes. When a click/submit step targets a dangerous control without confirm, the hand stops before that step with `status: approval_required`, `approvalRequired` (an ApprovalRequired body plus `step`), and `failedStep`.

get.description: Reports bounded, in-memory event timing diversity for the tab. The assessment is a local heuristic and does not claim acceptance by third-party bot detectors.

post.description: Physically resizes the page via Playwright's `page.setViewportSize`, triggering a real layout reflow. Use for responsive testing — `window.resizeTo()` is a no-op on non-popup windows.

400.description: Width or height missing or out of range.

get.description: Returns a PNG screenshot. When path is set, writes the PNG and returns JSON metadata instead of image bytes.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Destination PNG path. Relative paths resolve from GOLIATH_WORKSPACE when set, otherwise GOLIATH_SCREENSHOTS_DIR.

200.description: Screenshot PNG, or JSON metadata when path is set.

get.description: Returns tab metadata including URL, tool call count, visited URLs, download/failure counts.

post.description: Runs arbitrary JS in the page context and returns the result.

post.summary: Provenance-aware structured data extraction via JSON Schema
post.description:
Legacy mode resolves `x-ref` hints against the latest accessibility snapshot.
Semantic mode resolves durable `x-node-id` bindings against a versioned semantic
snapshot and returns confidence plus per-field evidence. Array schemas can supply
row bindings in `x-items`. No model fallback runs inside this endpoint.

snapshotId.description: Semantic snapshot ID returned by POST /tabs/{tabId}/observe.

mode.description: deterministic_then_model currently reports deterministic unresolved fields without invoking a model.

schema.description:
JSON Schema with object properties or an array of objects. Each property
may bind using `x-ref` (legacy) or `x-node-id` (semantic). Semantic array
schemas use `x-items`, an array of property-to-node-ID binding maps.

data.description: Extracted object or array matching the requested schema.

evidence.description: Per-field source snapshot and node provenance.

modelUsage.description: Reserved model-fallback usage; currently always null.

400.description: Missing userId, missing schema, or invalid schema.

409.description: Requested temporary refs or semantic snapshot are unavailable.

422.description: Extraction failed (e.g. required ref not found).

delete.summary: Close all tabs in a group

423.description: A tab in the group is paused for human handoff.

get.description: Returns all Playwright trace zip files for the given user session, sorted newest first.
Streams a Playwright trace zip for viewing in trace.playwright.dev.

delete.description: Removes a specific Playwright trace zip from the server.

200.description: Secret registered without echoing its value.

get.summary: Get the runtime capability policy for a session identity
get.description: Returns the operator-managed, runtime-only policy or null when unrestricted.

post.summary: Set or replace a runtime capability policy for a session identity
post.description: Works before the browser session exists. When GOLIATH_API_KEY is configured, only that dedicated key is accepted. The shared access key cannot administer policies.

delete.summary: Remove a runtime capability policy from a session identity
delete.description: Restores unrestricted behavior for the identity without deleting its browser session.

post.summary: Fork a session from a storage-state checkpoint

delete.description: Closes all tabs and cleans up state for the given userId.

423.description: Session contains a tab paused for human handoff.

get.description: Returns basic server liveness and browser state.

post.description: Ensures the browser process is running. Idempotent.
Privileged force-stop that terminates active human handoffs with an audited termination event, closes all sessions, and stops the browser. Requires x-admin-key header.
Navigate with targetId in body instead of path param.

get.description: Snapshot with targetId/userId as query params.

post.description: Routes to click/type/scroll/press/etc based on "kind" parameter.

kind.description: Action kind: click, type, scroll, scrollIntoView, press, hold, select_option, drag, hover, wait, or close.
